interpretations: For each country in `circuits`, average nonmissing `constructorStandings.points` and `constructorStandings.wins` across constructors within each race at its circuits, then average those race figures within the country so each race has equal weight; return the country averages and the country’s average wins minus the unrounded mean of all countries’ average wins, counting each country once.
queries:
WITH race_averages AS (
    SELECT raceId,
           AVG(points) AS avg_points,
           AVG(wins) AS avg_wins
    FROM constructorStandings
    GROUP BY raceId
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT c.country,
           AVG(ra.avg_points) AS avg_points,
           AVG(ra.avg_wins) AS avg_wins
    FROM circuits AS c
    LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    LEFT JOIN race_averages AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT country,
       avg_points,
       avg_wins,
       avg_wins - AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS wins_difference
FROM country_averages
